messages:
tess_ops: During the CEO Q&A at ~14:45 we had intermittent recorder failures on record05; audience asked if the session would be available later. Live stream remained but ~4s captions lag. @omar can you check record05 and OBS?

omar: Looking. Recorder crashed with segfault then auto-restarted. OBS switched to low-res backup scene to reduce load.

infra-bot: infra-alert: record05 process crashed: SIGSEGV at 2026-03-24T14:45:12Z. Restarted by systemd. No disk errors. Creating ticket INFRA-7433.

tess_ops: Can we confirm which segments are missing so Comms can message attendees?

louise (Comms): Please flag exact time window. We'll post an update: "Recording is being processed; a short clip around 14:44-14:46 may be incomplete. Full transcript will be shared." Need S3 link when available.

omar: Splicing available segments now. Uploading to s3://redwood-archives/allhands/record05/2026-03-24/ (team-read). Partial file names prefixed with "partial-".

qa-lyn: Pulling chat/Q&A sheet. One missed audience Q at 14:45: "Can you expand on the roadmap's migration phases?" I'll include in follow-up doc.

stream-monitor: monitor: captions fallback to internal ASR at 14:46, AV sync delta +4s for ~2m, packet loss nominal.

tess_ops: Action items: 1) omegar (omar) upload spliced files and mark partials, 2) postmortem draft (tess_ops) by EOD, 3) Comms to post status update (louise), 4) QA to compile missed questions (qa-lyn).

jen (CEO): Continue Q&A. We'll answer missed items after. Please cc me on follow-up Q list and postmortem. Thanks team for quick handling.

tess_ops: Noted. If anyone has local clips to preserve, paste S3 paths here. :thumbsup:
